title: permissions.json
description: The single canonical permission policy, in Claude Code rule syntax, that adapters translate into each runtime's native enforcement surface.
$comment: Unknown top-level keys are not rejected. defaultMode and blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories are passed through to the runtime without a check. Rule strings are not constrained to Tool(pattern) form: only Bash(...), Read(...) and Edit(...) rules are translated for runtimes other than Claude Code, and any other string passes through as written. additionalDirectories is checked only for being a list.

policyVersion.description: Bumped whenever the policy changes in a way an older checkout must not undo; a deploy refuses to write a lower version over a higher one.

defaultMode.description: The runtime's default permission mode; bypassPermissions suppresses approval prompts for unmatched work.

blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories.description: Passed through to Claude Code's permissions object.

additionalDirectories.description: Directories outside the working directory the policy treats as the user's own.

runtimeDirectories.description: Runtime-owned configuration roots that must remain writable to agents.

domains.description: Host pattern to allow or deny.

passthrough.description: Environment variable names passed through to the shell.

autoMode.description: Claude Code's auto-mode guidance block, passed through whole.
